title: UI Design Specification 1.0.0
description: Declarative reference only. The zero-dependency runtime validator scripts/lib/schema.mjs is the single source of truth and is stricter: it also checks hex color/format, font stack, spacing/radius bounds, shadow/border formats, unknown fields, size (1 MiB) and nesting-depth limits. Where this file and the runtime validator differ, the runtime validator wins.

designTokens.description: Structured design tokens (background, colors, typography, spacing, sizes, radius, shadows, borders); the runtime validator enforces hex and format limits per token.

layout.description: Free-form layout facts (regions, columns, primaryAction, ...). The runtime validator bounds size/depth and rejects unknown top-level fields.

content.description: Free-form product content (product name, heading, summary, tasks, progress, ...).
